title: Term Life Insurance Acceleration Administrative Charge by Life Expectancy
content:
**Fee schedule — Term Life Insurance terminal illness advances.** The administrative charge before courtesy is set by the physician-certified life expectancy on the approved accelerated benefit claim:

| Life expectancy | Administrative charge before courtesy |
|---|---|
| 3 months or less | nothing |
| 4 through 9 months | 100.00 |
| 10 months or more | the product's acceleration administrative fee (150.00 on every tier) |

Both sides of the thresholds (hypothetical): 3 months — nothing; 4 months — 100.00; 9 months — 100.00; 10 months — 150.00.
